title: Case 1: Constitution of Municipalities (Urban 3-Tier Structure) (Article 243Q • Writ Petition)
factualMatrix: Before the Supreme Court of India (Article 32), an aggrieved petitioner challenged an impugned executive notification and enforcement order issued by the Union Ministry / Central Authority under Article 243Q (Constitution of Municipalities (Urban 3-Tier Structure)) of Part IX-A (The Municipalities).
